style: Barbershop vocal group and acoustic string-band stomp. Harmony: Barbershop-style voice leading with ringing dominant tension and non-diatonic cluster rubs. Melody: Fast scat contour with yodel register flips and ornamental folk turns. Rhythm: Waltz pulse invaded by swinging triplets and abrupt metric compression. Timbre: Upright bass, brushed snare, fiddle, parlor organ, and close-miked vocal group. Performance: Theatrical overstatement played completely straight with deadpan administrative precision. Production: Dry acoustic close-mic capture with 1960s mono-to-stereo room bleed and sudden dynamic dropouts. Operators: Hold the acoustic waltz pulse fixed while barbershop harmony migrates; compress the lyrical syntax while stretching the vocal melisma; make string arrangements behave like a malfunctioning filing cabinet without becoming noise; preserve the close-harmony anchor while destabilizing the rhythmic meter; force incompatible temporal scales to coexist in tight counterpoint; return to the rhythmic anchor in a more mutated, frantic form.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
[Tightly stacked barbershop harmony, dry close-miked acoustic instruments]
[Acoustic waltz pulse with brushed snare]
The geometry is leaking down the hallway.
We filed the corners under section seven,
And now the walls are liquid and behaving.
[Fiddle interjection with rapid chromatic turns]
Did someone leave the facets slightly open?
The paperweights are swimming in the ceiling.
[Rapid patter singing]
Check the ledger, count the angles, hold the baseline steady while the ceiling turns around!

[Chorus]
[Massed close-harmony doo-wop vocals, upright bass thump, parlor organ swells]
Oh, the tesseract has been drinking again!
Pouring dimensions straight down the drain!
It started with a cube and a mild inclination,
Now we are trapped in a non-Euclidean station!
[Yodel register flip]
Yodel-ay-hee, watch the vertex slide!
There is nowhere left in the room to hide!

[Verse 2]
[Deadpan spoken narration over walking upright bass and scattered fiddle notes]
According to the supervisor's memo,
Solid objects must remain orthogonal.
Instead, the fifth dimension smells like gin,
And heavy furniture is crawling through the skin of the partition.
[Scat syllables as percussion: bop-sh-bop, zoot-zoot]
We tried to measure the hangover of a sphere,
And found three extra Sundays trapped inside the year.

[Chorus]
[Full ensemble barbershop stack, frantic waltz beat, handclaps]
Oh, the tesseract has been drinking again!
Pouring dimensions straight down the drain!
It started with a cube and a mild inclination,
Now we are trapped in a non-Euclidean station!
[Yodel register flip]
Yodel-ay-hee, watch the vertex slide!
There is nowhere left in the room to hide!

[Bridge]
[Abrupt drop to dry unaccompanied close-harmony voices, whispering rhythm]
Whisper the coordinates. Do not let the edges hear you.
Fold the paper. Crease the shadow.
Swallow the diagonal before it wakes up.
[Sudden explosive band entry: fiddle, organ, frantic strumming]
It is singing in radians! It is dancing in hyper-space!

[Verse 3]
[Patter singing at near-spoken speed, swinging triplet rhythm over waltz pulse]
The mathematics department is under the table.
The algebra is crying in the hall.
We bolted down the floorboards with a cable,
But gravity is vertical no more at all.
[Hocketed vocal fragments passed between voices]
Top? Bottom? Left? Right? Gone!

[Guitar and fiddle trading fast chromatic runs]

[Chorus]
[Ecstatic massed vocal delivery, maximum energy, room bleed saturation]
Oh, the tesseract has been drinking again!
Pouring dimensions straight down the drain!
It started with a cube and a mild inclination,
Now we are trapped in a non-Euclidean station!
[High register yodel and barbershop chord cluster]
Yodel-ay-hee, watch the vertex slide!
There is nowhere left in the room to hide!

[Outro]
[Music abruptly cuts to a single dry upright bass note and spoken deadpan voice]
Session closed. The fourth dimension is sleeping it off.
[Faint clink of a falling glass, single whispered chord]
[End]
caption: An acoustic barbershop string-band novelty track where traditional close-harmony vocals and waltz rhythms collide with an intoxicated multi-dimensional geometry. The arrangement combines tight vocal stacking, rapid scat patter, and yodel register flips with dry close-miked instrumentation, creating a frantic, structurally unstable folk performance driven by strict administrative absurdity.
